description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named ActionBarUsage that demonstrates the usage of the Action Bar, including menu inflation, handling of menu item selections, search view integration, and dynamic icon updates.

classes.name: ActionBarUsage
classes.description: An Activity that demonstrates the use of the Action Bar, including menu actions, search functionality, and dynamic menu icon updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, creates a TextView for displaying search text, and sets it as the content view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu resource into the action bar and sets up the SearchView's query text listener.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Dynamically updates the sort icon in the menu if mSortMode is set.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection by displaying a toast message with the selected item's title.

methods.name: onSort
methods.description: Handles sorting action, updates mSortMode, and requests menu refresh to update icon.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Updates the TextView with the current query text or a placeholder message if empty.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Displays a toast indicating a search has been initiated with the submitted query.
